name: Presidio Tunnel Tops, the Main Post, the Golden Gate Bridge and the Marin Headlands
note: The Presidio of San Francisco seen from the Tunnel Tops and the Main Post (the Walt Disney Family Museum and the Montgomery Street barracks on the Main Parade Ground, the Officers' Club, the Visitor Center), the Presidio Tunnel Tops park over the Presidio Parkway, Crissy Field and the Bay, Fort Point and the whole Golden Gate Bridge with the Marin Headlands behind it (Lime Point, Battery Spencer, Vista Point, Kirby Cove, the ridge toward Hawk Hill). Scale 0.5 blocks per metre and turned 5.34 degrees (the bridge deck along z), the same frame conventions as sf/presidio-ggb, so its bridge kits drop in. Grown 2026-10-19 from 1100 to 2400 blocks a side to the north-west (every old block +1300, +1300); Marin's lidar from the 2010 Golden Gate survey where the 2023 San Francisco flight stops.
